name: Getz
source:
Getz is kind of cagey about where he's originally from... all I know is it seems very unlike here, very grim and complicated. I know him from Study Hall, where he's most often hanging out in a corner away from everyone else. He seems to like Tough people.

[From in-game profile]

The character originally appeared in [url=http://www.deadstate.doublebearproductions.com/]Dead State[/url].
